options.name: groups
options.description: Set this option to set the scope to group level A list with groupnames where the policy should be changed

options.name: inherit
options.description: Inherit policy from upper scope If set to yes I(policy) will be ignored and the policy will be inherited from upper scope

options.name: policy
options.description: Define the settings which should be set in policy. Available options can be referred in API documentation e.g. agentUiOn or snapshotsOn Required if I(inherit=no) Will be ignored if I(inherit=yes)

options.name: site_name
options.description: Name of the site in SentinelOne

options.name: token
options.description: SentinelOne API auth token to authenticate at the management API
